it is not the amount of data that matters, but the way how data is used.

The main takeaway from our work is that
even with limited information, it is possible with machine learning to develop predictive models that can be used to optimize maintenance strategies and to reduce costs.
the development of a predictive maintenance strategy is possible even with a limited amount of training data.
the development of a predictive maintenance strategy is not a one-time task but requires continuous monitoring of the system and a constant reevaluation of the predictive model.
